verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the official Go SDK's CheckWithContext, which checks availability of one or more domains, and GetTldListWithContext, which lists supported TLDs. That supports programmatic availability lookup, but nothing shows the search is fast or that it suggests alternate TLDs, and nothing addresses whether searched names are protected from front-running or squatting. Missing for 10: evidence of instant or real-time availability results, alternate TLD suggestions in search, a policy or proof against lookup-then-squat, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search behavior.
